## Definition in words

Named pathology — diagnoses, syndromes, neoplasms, injuries and pathologic processes. What a phenotype definition is usually written in terms of. Separated from `symptom` because "the model missed the diagnosis" and "the model missed the symptom" are different failures.

A semantic-type partition of an anchored parent. The parent's boundary is validated; **the split within it is not adjudicated by any corpus**. Report the parent's metrics and label this as a refinement.
